name: Butter Bridge retry-message hash collision
summary: Butter Bridge stored failed-message commitments with abi.encodePacked over adjacent dynamic byte fields. The attacker retried a valid failed message with different field boundaries but the same packed preimage, redirecting execution to MAPO and minting one quadrillion unbacked tokens.
notes: Code defect, not key compromise: the attacker's own cross-chain message failed (NotContract) and was stored by the relayer; the retry re-split the packed bytes. The relayer delivery is setup; the retry is the first tx the forged message executed.

Unbacked MAPO has no realisable mark; the loss is the ETH the attacker realised dumping into the Uniswap v4 pool. The BSC leg minted the same amount of MAPO but nothing from it was sold, so it adds no loss.
